definitions.gloss: starting lineup; starting member; first-choice player
definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of スターティングメンバー (starting member). Refers to the players who start a game, as opposed to substitutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スタメン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}された→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怪我|けが}→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}して→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧スタメン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: He returned to the starting lineup after recovering from his injury.

examples.japanese: スタメン{落|お}ち⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧。
examples.english: I'm frustrated about being dropped from the starting lineup.

notes:
Abbreviation of スターティングメンバー (starting member). Used in sports to refer to the players selected to start a game.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- スタメン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ / スタメン{入|い}り: to make the starting lineup
- スタメン{落|お}ち: to be dropped from the starting lineup
- スタメン⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧: competition for a starting position
- スタメン⟦{固定|こてい}→固定：10996_kotei⟧: a fixed/unchanged starting lineup
- スタメン⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: starting lineup announcement

OPPOSITE:
- ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧: bench (substitute players)
- ⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: reserve player
- ⟦サブ→サブ：noentry⟧: substitute

USAGE:
Commonly used in baseball, soccer, and other team sports. In casual conversation, スタメン can also be used figuratively to mean "first choice" or "regular" in non-sports contexts.
